tasks.short: Get missed-bin calls and bulky waste bookings from the office, organize the day's collection schedule, agree swaps with the crew and depot, and tick off done and missed stops.

steps.what: Resident phones to report a missed bin or book a bulky waste pickup
Refuse collector picks up the list of extra pickups and missed bins from the depot office
Refuse collector organizes schedules for refuse collection: street order and extra pickups for the day
Refuse collector agrees the schedule and swaps with the crew and the depot planner
Refuse collector notes done and missed stops on the paper route sheet

tasks.design: Residents report missed bins and book bulky waste pickups in the municipality's waste app ({GOV_PORTAL}), and the requests land on the route list on the cab tablet ({OPS_SYSTEM}). A route planner in the same system puts the fixed collection calendar and the day's extra pickups in a proposed street order, which the collector checks and adjusts. Stops are ticked on the tablet, and missed stops carry a reason code. Agreeing swaps with the crew and the depot stays in person; tablet data are kept per truck, not used to rate collectors.
tasks.previous_blocker: Extra pickups came on paper from the office, and rounds were planned and ticked off on paper sheets.
tasks.enabler_now: Waste collection systems combine resident requests, route planning and cab tablets.
tasks.still_hard: Road works, parked cars and full trucks change the plan during the day.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing which narrow street to do before the school run.
tasks.altitude: The collector adjusts a proposed route instead of building it.

evidence.claim: Waste collection systems combine resident requests, route planning and in-cab tablets.
Devices that log work per person can observe performance, so the works council must consent before use.

assumptions: Boundary: from resident requests to the route record; emptying containers is outside.
Input contract: collection calendar set by the municipality's waste planner; pickup requests entered by residents in the app or by the office for callers; fallback is the paper list.
Residents' time is priced as customer time, not as the collector's savings.

already_counted.description: Refuse collector checks and adjusts the proposed route.

incremental.description: Refuse collector reports wrong addresses in the route data.
Residents report missed bins and book bulky waste pickups in the app instead of phoning.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Crews on fixed rounds with few extra pickups save less.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The refuse collector keeps agreeing the day with the crew and adjusting routes; paper lists and route sheets go.
skills_to_grow: Checking proposed routes on the tablet
role.ambitious_version: A crew that starts the round with requests and route already set.
